git.hintGithub: Repository Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook. Paste both values above, set the content type to application/json, then pick Let me select individual events and tick only Pull requests.
git.hintGitlab: Project Settings → Webhooks → Add new webhook. Paste the URL, put the secret in Secret token, and tick only Merge request events.
git.hintGitea: Repository Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook, type Gitea (Forgejo on Forgejo). Paste both values above, set the content type to application/json, and under Trigger On pick Custom events → Pull request.
git.hintBitbucket: Repository Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook. Paste both values above, open the full list of triggers, and pick Pull request: Created and Merged. Bitbucket doesn't send the default branch, so a merge into any branch closes the issue.
